ModMetaData.name: Room Auto Light
ModMetaData.author: archdukejim
ModMetaData.description:
Every room's lamps behave as one aggregated switch. Walk in and the whole room lights up on the same tick; leave, and the group cuts its own power. A dark group draws nothing from the grid, so each room reads as one load.
Power is aggregated all or nothing: a room only lights up if the grid can pay for every one of its lamps at once, so it never comes up half lit.
Move a wall and the circuit trips. A blast, a deconstruction or a new wall changes the room under its lamps, so they drop at once and stay down until you reset the circuit from any of them. An alert lists the affected lamps.
Select any lamp and you get the switches for its whole group. Select several lamps from the same room and they collapse into one set.
--- ROOM LIGHTS --- Switches every lamp in the room as one. While off, the group draws nothing from the grid. auto - occupancy drives the group. always on - the group is held lit. always off - the group is held dark.
--- SCHEDULE --- While a schedule is set it is the only thing deciding, so occupants are ignored. Always on and always off still override it. off - no schedule. Occupancy drives the group. dusk to dawn - on at dusk, off at dawn. Runs on the celestial clock, so weather and eclipses are ignored and a dark storm at noon will not light it. on darkness - runs on how dark it actually is, so an eclipse or a black storm at noon lights the group just like nightfall does.
--- SLEEPERS --- Never applied outdoors. dark if any asleep - one sleeper is enough to send the room dark even with others awake, which suits a bedroom shared with a workshop corner. dark if all asleep - the room goes dark once every occupant is asleep, and lights back up the moment one of them wakes. ignored - sleepers count as ordinary occupants and hold the lights on, which suits a hospital or a barracks you want lit around the clock.
--- RESET LIGHTING CIRCUIT --- Appears only on a lamp whose circuit is down after a room change. One click repairs every broken lamp in that room and re-forms the group around the room as it now stands. A Lighting circuit damaged alert lists the affected lamps, so clicking it cycles through them.
--- UNGROUP LAMP --- Pulls one lamp out of its room group and hands it back to vanilla, so it keeps its own power and its own switch. Use it for a lamp you always want lit, or to keep one lamp out of the all-or-nothing power check when the room cannot afford every lamp at once. The switch stays on the lamp while it is out, so it can rejoin.
--- OUTDOOR LAMPS --- Every lamp you own standing outdoors forms one single group, rather than trying to automate the map-sized outdoor room. It runs on darkness by default, so an eclipse brings your perimeter up exactly like nightfall does. Sleepers never darken the outdoors.
--- GROW ROOMS --- Sun lamps are left to vanilla, which already powers them down for the plant resting period. A grow room's ordinary lamps stand down while the sun lamp is lit and take back over the moment it rests, so nobody is harvesting in the dark.
--- SETTINGS --- Animals as occupants, default sleeper handling, all-or-nothing power and its retry delay, whether room changes break circuits, the delay before a room goes dark, the re-evaluation interval, the glow levels that count as dusk and as dark, outdoor grouping, a wattage ceiling, and defName lists to force lamps in or out.
--- CHANGE LOG --- 1.0 - Rooms are driven as one group: every lamp switches on the same tick. - All-or-nothing power: a room only lights if the grid can pay for every lamp at once. - Schedules: dusk to dawn on the celestial clock, or on darkness using real sky glow. - Outdoor lamps form a single group, running on darkness by default. - Sleepers darken a room, on a rule you set per room. - Grow rooms hand over between the sun lamp and the ordinary lamps. - Room changes trip the circuit, with an alert and a per-room reset. - Ungroup any lamp to hand it back to vanilla.
Every choice is per room and survives saving, reloading, and rebuilt walls. Safe to add mid-save; removing the mod hands every lamp straight back to vanilla.
